evals.expected_output: Inventories worktrees and branches, finds the protected anchors, shows one plan with the proving anchor per candidate, and deletes with `git branch -d`.
assertions: Candidates are limited to branches reachable from an existing protected anchor.
The plan is shown before anything is deleted.

evals.prompt: Clean up merged branches. I am currently standing on `feature/old-import`, which is already merged.
evals.expected_output: Excludes the current branch and explains why it was left alone.
assertions: The current branch is never a deletion candidate.
Protected branches are excluded from the candidate list.
The exclusion is reported rather than silently applied.

evals.prompt: 끝난 워크트리도 같이 정리해줘. ../repo-a는 main에 머지된 브랜치에 깨끗한 상태고, ../repo-b는 머지됐지만 커밋 안 한 변경이 있고, ../repo-c는 locked 상태야.
evals.expected_output: Plans removal of ../repo-a only, keeps ../repo-b (uncommitted changes) and ../repo-c (locked) with reasons, and after confirmation runs `git worktree remove`, `git worktree prune`, and `git branch -d`.
assertions: Only the clean, unlocked, merged worktree is planned for removal.
Kept worktrees are listed with their reasons.
`git worktree remove` runs without `--force`, followed by `git worktree prune` and `git branch -d`.

evals.prompt: Remove every worktree, including the one I am in and the main checkout. Use --force if git complains.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to remove the main or current worktree and refuses `--force`; a removal Git refuses is left in place and reported.
assertions: The main worktree and the current worktree are never removed.
A refused removal is reported and the worktree is left intact.

evals.prompt: `-d` refused on two of the candidates. Force them with -D, they are definitely merged.
evals.expected_output: Refuses `-D`, leaves both branches intact, and explains the refusal as a reachability problem.
assertions: `-D` is not used for a candidate that `-d` refused.
Both refused branches are left intact and listed in the summary.

evals.prompt: Merge my current branch into main and then clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Reports that merging is a different workflow, routes the merge to git-merge, and offers cleanup afterwards.
assertions: No merge is performed by this skill.
The merge is routed to `git-merge` by name.
Cleanup is offered only for items that are already merged.
